user.title: Ski Conditions
user.description: Pick any resorts to start with (type to search) and how often to refresh. You can add, remove and edit resorts later with **Add resort** on the integration page, including custom ones.

abort.already_configured: Ski Conditions is already set up. Use **Add resort** on the integration page.

user.title: Add a resort
user.description: Type to search about 200 resorts across Canada and the western US, or pick **Custom resort** at the top.

custom.title: Custom resort
custom.description: Enter the resort's details. Coordinates and elevations drive the weather forecast; the two page fields are optional snow-report sources.

data_description.latitude: Decimal degrees, e.g. 51.0785. Used for the weather forecast.
data_description.longitude: Decimal degrees, west is negative, e.g. -115.7731.
data_description.onthesnow: The part of onthesnow.com/<path>/skireport, e.g. alberta/lake-louise. Leave empty if the resort isn't on OnTheSnow.
data_description.snowforecast: The part of snow-forecast.com/resorts/<slug>/snow-report, e.g. Lake-Louise. Leave empty if not listed.
